d:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.
I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.
If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
c:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers.
Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.

d:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.
You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.
p: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
c:
Thanks for delivering this, pal.
Wait... He said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!
Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

d: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
p: Ah, another gnome comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.
c: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!

d:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.
I usually avoid dealing with adventurers if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
p: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the travelers.
c:
You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.
Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.
Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.

d:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the adventurer trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
p: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
c:
Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.
When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.

d: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the adventurer trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
p: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of an adventurer.
c: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new adventurers learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
